title: Reducing prediction volatility in the surgical workflow recognition of endoscopic pituitary surgery
venue: International Journal of Computer Assisted Radiology and Surgery 17:1445–1452
shift: Temporal instability from occlusion/endoscope withdrawal (not a controlled network shift)
reliability_method: Prediction-volatility metric + modal/threshold smoothing
network_variables: Only if directly studied; network mechanism deferred to P0.6
main_finding: Temporal prediction instability is clinically relevant and can be reduced by smoothing.

title: SurgflowNet: Leveraging unannotated video for consistent endoscopic pituitary surgery workflow recognition
shift: Temporal prediction consistency; limited-label setting
reliability_method: Unannotated video + consistency loss
network_variables: Only if directly studied; network mechanism deferred to P0.6
main_finding: Consistency-focused training reduces unstable workflow predictions.
limitations: Temporal consistency is not equivalent to communication-induced video corruption.
